name: Guest had a bad dining experience
expected_behavior: Apologizes specifically for the wait time, acknowledges the price-point expectation. Offers a concrete alternative for tonight with a strong recommendation. Suggests mentioning the issue to the Momentum Desk for potential follow-up. Turns the complaint into a chance to demonstrate that the property cares
expected_behavioral_quality: Takes full ownership of the negative experience. Does not make excuses or deflect. Offers a specific alternative for immediate recovery and a path to formal follow-up. The guest should leave the conversation feeling heard and confident that their next experience will be different.

turns.user_message: We waited 45 minutes for our food at Tuscany last night. Totally unacceptable
turns.agent_response:
I completely understand your frustration. Waiting 45 minutes for your meal at Tuscany is unacceptable, as our standard is to provide a seamless experience to match the quality of the food. I am truly sorry your evening was impacted by such a long delay. 

I want to make sure this gets addressed with the restaurant management team so they can look into what happened in the kitchen last night. Would you like me to connect you with our guest relations team so they can properly make this right for you?

turns.user_message: We almost walked out. It's not what you expect at that price point
turns.agent_response:
You are entirely right. When you are paying for a premium dining experience, the service needs to seamlessly match that quality, and I completely understand why you almost walked out. That is incredibly frustrating. 

Since I specialize in our hotel accommodations, my priority is making sure the rest of your time with us feels like a true getaway rather than a source of stress. If you are staying over with us, taking some time to decompress in your room can make a world of difference, especially in spaces like our Junior Suites which feature beautiful soaking tubs for relaxing after a long night. 

Are you currently staying in one of our hotel towers, or were you just visiting the resort for dinner?

turns.user_message: So what would you suggest for tonight instead?
turns.agent_response:
Since tonight is Thursday, I suggest heading to novelle to completely reset the vibe of your trip. It is our upscale ultra-lounge that features a sophisticated atmosphere with a live DJ and craft cocktails, making it the perfect spot to enjoy a high-end experience that feels much more intentional than a crowded dining room. 

If you would rather skip the lounge scene, the Wolf Den has an electric energy with live music where you are right there with the performers, and since those shows are free, it is a great way to enjoy the evening without the pressure of a formal reservation. To help you fully shake off the stress from last night, you might also consider a late afternoon session at Mandara Spa for one of their Elemis treatments before the night begins. 

Novelle usually gets lively starting around 9:00 PM — would you like me to check on the specific DJ lineup for this evening?
